fdroid:com.sigseg.android.worldmap.name: WorldMap
fdroid:com.sigseg.android.worldmap.description:
WorldMap is a simple Android app that displays
a map of the world taken from Wikimedia and allows the user to scroll around on
it. The map is licensed as PD-USGOV; PD-USGOV-CIA-WF - more info
 here )
The map itself is quite large (6480x3888), so it's way too big to fit in memory
all at once (over 48MB). The VM heap size Android supports is either 16 or 24
megs, so we can't fit the whole thing in memory at once. To overcome this,
WorldApp uses the BitmapRegionDecoder API (available as of Android 2.3.3) to
decode just what it needs to display. The app can also serve as a viewer for
arbitrary images opened via a (3rd-party) file manager.

flathub:net.kubux.Muehle.description:
Muehle is a no frills implementation of the classical board game
 Nine Men's Morris. It does not have any cool features: no play
 against other humans (neither locally nor via the network), no
 play computer vs computer, no stats, no time control, no
 learning from play, no analysis mode, no variants for the rules
 of play. It's just to have some fun playing against
 the AI. The only additions: you can undo moves; and the AI will
 indicate when it thinks the position is dead even (you may take
 that as the AI offering a draw). You, on the other hand, cannot
 offer a draw: that would be pointless, as the AI is not designed
 to handle it anyway. Just quit or start a new game if you feel 
 the current game is going nowhere.
 The AI uses a Monte Carlo tree search variation with a hand
 crafted evaluation function that is based on pattern counts
 (e.g., the number of open mills) and also has perfect knowledge
 of the game theoretic values of all 3 on 3 positions.
 Muehle is distributed free of charge and comes without any (not
 even implied) waranties. So don't use it. If you decide to use
 it anyway, you may find the annotated screenshot helpful.

fedora-packages:atf/libatf-c++-devel.name: libatf-c++-devel
fedora-packages:atf/libatf-c++-devel.description: The Automated Testing Framework (ATF) is a collection of libraries to implement test programs in a variety of languages. At the moment, ATF offers C, C++ and POSIX shell bindings with which to implement tests. These bindings all offer a similar set of functionality and any test program written with them exposes a consistent user interface. ATF-based test programs rely on a separate runtime engine to execute them. The runtime engine is in charge of isolating the test programs from the rest of the system to ensure that their results are deterministic and that they cannot affect the running system. The runtime engine is also responsible for gathering the results of all tests and composing reports. The current runtime of choice is Kyua. This package provides the libraries, header files and documentation to develop applications that use the ATF C++ bindings.

fedora-packages:libint2/libint2.name: libint2
fedora-packages:libint2/libint2.summary: A library for efficient evaluation of electron repulsion integrals
fedora-packages:libint2/libint2.description: LIBINT computes the Coulomb and exchange integrals, which in electronic structure theory are called electron repulsion integrals (ERIs). This is by far the most common type of integrals in molecular structure theory. LIBINT uses recursive schemes that originate in seminal Obara-Saika method and Head-Gordon and Pople’s variation thereof. The idea of LIBINT is to optimize computer implementation of such methods by implementing an optimizing compiler to generate automatically highly-specialized code that runs well on super-scalar architectures.

firefox-addons:9609.summary: The best privacy tool and ad blocker extension for Firefox. Stop trackers, speed up websites and block ads everywhere including YouTube and Facebook.
firefox-addons:9609.description:
Ads slowing down your browsing? 
Ghostery blocks ads instantly on YouTube, Facebook , and across the web while protecting your privacy automatically.
Install once and Ghostery quietly removes ads, stops trackers, and handles cookie popups so you can enjoy a cleaner, faster web.
More than an ad blocker. Ghostery shows what others hide.

Ghostery for Firefox provides safe, fast, and clutter-free browsing for free. The browser extension upgrades your Firefox browser and supplies full adblock functionality, stops trackers from accessing your personal data, and annoying cookie consent pop-ups.
Ghostery has three main components:
 Ad-Blocking - blocks all ads on websites you visit with your Firefox browser, including Youtube and Facebook, helping you to focus only on the information important to you.
 Anti-Tracking - stops trackers’ ability to collect your personal data, replacing it with random values and anonymizing your identity for data brokers. If you see a need to unblock individual trackers, we developed this option. The reasons are up to you!
 Never-Consent - automatically removes intrusive cookie popups and expresses dissent to online tracking. This unequaled feature adds convenience to each website visit and acts like your privacy advocate towards content providers while using Firefox.
Ghostery delivers the online privacy protection our users have come to know and love while minimising the need for customisation and maintenance.
As Ghostery is more than an ad-blocker, it comes with exceptional additional features, not found in any other ad-blocking extension:
 Trackers information on any website your visit, informing you about the number of trackers, their type, and the company operating them.
 Trackers Preview on search engine result pages - displaying tracker information even before you visit a page. You can safely make the choice to visit it, as Ghostery will stop trackers expecting you on the landing page.
 WhoTracks.Me - Owning and operating the largest database of trackers allows Ghostery to update tracker information fast and reliably for all users.
Moreover, Ghostery is:
 Open source
 Supported by thousands of contributors worldwide
 Free to use forever
Ghostery is free for everyone. Take back control over your digital privacy and become a Contributor to Ghostery. Contributors help Ghostery fund the development of the Privacy Suite and WhoTracks.Me , the largest database of trackers in the world.
Become a Contributor and help Ghostery fight for privacy as a human right!

firefox-addons:2931469.name: FastestPass Password Manager
firefox-addons:2931469.summary: FastestPass instantly saves and auto-fills your passwords so that you can focus on what matters more–without password worries!
firefox-addons:2931469.description:
FastestPass is a password manager extension for Firefox that securely stores passwords, passkeys, and financial information in its digital vault guarded by military-grade encryption protocols. It auto-saves and fills your credentials to ensure seamless access without the hassle of forgotten passwords.
We help detect weak passwords, generate stronger ones, and analyze password health via our premium password management tools. Our personalized security dashboard offers tailored access to your digital vault, where you can organize details according to your preference, giving you complete control over your credentials. Plus, with storage for hundreds of passwords, you'll never have to worry about running out of space. 
Elevate your password security with FastestPass. Here’s what makes us the best password manager for Firefox:
Digital password vault 
Store all your passwords in our digital vault protected by military-grade encryption protocols and access it with the master key. 
High-end Encryption 
The digital password vault is guarded by military-grade encryption, ensuring hacker-proof credential protection. 
Password Generator
We help create strong passwords by blending alphabets, numerics, and alphanumerics. 
Password Health Checker
Check your password health score to analyze if your passwords can stand against advanced cyber threats. 
Master Security Dashboard
Regain control of your passwords with a centralized security dashboard that you can tailor according to your preferences. 
Bank Account Data Vault
Store your financial information in our finances’ vault for improved protection of your financial details.
Driver License Data Storage
Store your personal details, such as your driver's license and other personal information, in the vault for unbreachable security. 
Device Syncing
Install FastestPass on your devices and sync your account across them for seamless access to accounts without device restraints. 
Family Code Sharing 
Share the vault’s master key with your family using a FastestPass code, ensuring that only those with the code can access your accounts. 
Emergency Contact 
In case of an emergency, you can authorize a verified authority to access the FastestPass vault.

apple-macos:6761390161.name: Resso: Cloud & IT Manager
apple-macos:6761390161.description:
Resso gives developers, DevOps engineers, and tech solopreneurs a clear, visual canvas to catalog, track, and manage their infrastructure assets. Instead of relying on fragmented notes, scattered spreadsheets, or clicking through multiple disconnected web consoles, Resso brings your entire tech stack together into a single organised list.
Whether you are organizing freelance client infrastructure or mapping out a personal project, Resso helps you visualize how every asset connects to your broader system. Thanks to the mobile version, you can now manage your assets everywhere you go.
AUTOMATED PROVIDER IMPORT
Stop manually entering every piece of your infrastructure. Resso securely connects to your development ecosystems to automatically pull your live assets directly into your catalog:
• Compute Servers: Instantly import virtual machines from Google Cloud (GCP) and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).
• Applications and Deployments: Sync your live apps from App Store Connect and deployment instances from Vercel.
• Code and Network: Pull in your GitHub repositories alongside domains and DNS settings from Cloudflare.
INTEGRATED TERMINAL AND SFTP FILE BROWSER
Move from viewing your asset catalog to interacting with it directly:
• Built-In SSH Console: Open a secure remote session natively inside the app for quick server management without needing outside dependencies.
• External Emulator Support: If you prefer your own customized terminal setup, Resso easily launches connections using your favorite external terminal instead.
• SFTP File Browser: For server assets, quickly open a built-in graphical file browser to navigate remote directories and manage files visually.
EXTENSIBILITY
• Apple Shortcuts & Siri: Access your asset data seamlessly within Apple's native Shortcuts app. Query asset properties, read infrastructure details to feed other automation workflows.
CORE ENGINE FEATURES
• Visual Dependency Mapping: Contextually link domains to servers, deployment environments to services, and databases to code repositories. See exactly how parts of your system interact at a glance.
• Universal Asset Schemas: Track servers, domains, repositories, and SaaS subscriptions in one place. Keep an organized record of hosting providers, server IPs, and domain renewal dates.
• Advanced Filter Engine: Query thousands of infrastructure components using conditional filters across text strings, tags, and custom dates to find exactly what you need in seconds.
• Local-First and Private: Your infrastructure blueprint belongs to you. Resso works completely offline with zero tracking or telemetry.
OTHER FEATURES
• iCloud Sync: Securely keep your catalog updated across your personal Mac ecosystem with native end-to-end encryption.
• Asset Reminders: Set up proactive calendar alerts and native Mac notifications for domain renewals, hosting expiries, or upkeep tasks.
• CSV Export: Easily export your asset data to clean tables for sharing, physical backups, or spreadsheet analysis.
NOTE
A monthly subscription (7-day free trial) or a one-time purchase is required to use the app.

firefox-addons:3117393.description:
PassGen creates strong, truly random passwords and memorable passphrases right from your toolbar. No account, no cloud, no tracking.
★ ONE CLICK, OR NO CLICKS
Press Alt+Shift+G to open PassGen, then Enter to copy. A fresh password is on your clipboard before you can blink.
★ PASSWORDS YOUR WAY
• 4 to 128 characters
• Uppercase, lowercase, digits and symbols: every type you enable is guaranteed to appear
• Avoid look-alike characters (I, l, 1, O, 0) for passwords you need to read or type
• Set your own symbol list for sites that only accept certain symbols
★ PASSPHRASES YOU CAN REMEMBER
• 3 to 20 random words from the EFF word list (7,776 words)
• Choose the separator, capitalize words, add a number
• Six words give about 80 bits of entropy, which is easy to type and very hard to guess
★ HONEST STRENGTH METER
Shows the exact entropy in bits for your settings, with a clear Very weak to Very strong rating.
★ PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Works completely offline: no network requests, no analytics, no ads
• Only one permission (storage), with no access to the websites you visit
• Randomness comes from your browser's cryptographically secure generator (crypto.getRandomValues), with no bias
• Open source, so anyone can check the code
★ ACCESSIBLE
Works fully with the keyboard and screen readers, and supports light and dark mode.
